input.quote: Any writing or work of authorship created by M&I in the course of performing the Services under this Agreement, even if paid for by Customer, shall be the property of M&I ("Developed Software"). M&I may make such Developed Software available to any of its other customers
input.rationale: Section 10.4 gives M&I outright ownership of work of authorship created for and paid for by us, and lets M&I resell it to other customers, with no licence back; Section 17.2 reinforces that we have "no rights" in M&I materials except use "during the Term to process its data", and the Article 23 source-code licence (IBS Software only) runs only through the end of the Term and bars sublicensing. The clause therefore fails the IP fallback. We target the fallback (M&I retains ownership of its programs and know-how, we take a broad licence) rather than reversing ownership, which would require collateral rewrites. The redline (i) inserts the perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, royalty-free licence to use, modify and sublicense Developed Software, (ii) conforms 17.2 so the Term-limited "no rights" acknowledgement no longer contradicts that licence, and (iii) narrows M&I's use of Customer Data in 17.4 itself, where the broader "purposes contemplated by this Agreement" permission sits, keeping the mutual confidentiality standard otherwise intact. Section 17.1's sole-ownership sentence is left untouched.

proposal.summary: Add perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, royalty-free Developed Software licence, conform 17.2, and limit M&I's use of Customer Data in 17.4 to providing the Services
proposal.comment: [Playbook] M&I keeps ownership of the Developed Software we pay for with no licence back, so we have added the playbook fallback licence (perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, royalty-free, with rights to use, modify and sublicense for our business) and conformed the Section 17.2 "no rights" acknowledgement to it. We have also limited M&I's use of Customer Data in Section 17.4 to providing the Services.

ops.text: License to Developed Software. M&I grants Customer a perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, royalty-free license to use, modify and sublicense the Developed Software for Customer's business.

ops.oldText: Customer acknowledges that it has no rights in any software, systems, documentation, guidelines, procedures and similar related materials or any modifications thereof provided by M&I, except with respect to Customer's use of the same during the Term to process its data.
ops.newText: Customer acknowledges that it has no rights in any software, systems, documentation, guidelines, procedures and similar related materials or any modifications thereof provided by M&I, except with respect to Customer's use of the same during the Term to process its data and except as expressly licensed to Customer under Section 10.5.

ops.oldText: M&I and Customer shall hold the Confidential Information of the other party in confidence and shall not disclose or use such Confidential Information other than for the purposes contemplated by this Agreement,
ops.newText: M&I and Customer shall hold the Confidential Information of the other party in confidence and shall not disclose or use such Confidential Information other than for the purposes contemplated by this Agreement, provided that M&I shall use Customer Data solely to provide the Services,
